0.8.4.title: Show freedom: see what can still move in a sketch
0.8.4.blurb: Amber marks the points and radii that are not fully defined, says in which direction they can move and offers chips that pin them; Show constraints draws every glyph and dimension and lists what is attached on hover.

0.8.4.title: A Hole tool that starts from a face
0.8.4.blurb: Pick the flat face, type the centres, set a diameter that is remembered for the next hole, and choose Blind or Through.

0.8.4.title: Type a first point as x,y
0.8.4.blurb: Start a circle, line, point, rectangle or arc by typing its position; the point is dimensioned from the origin and expressions stay linked to variables.

0.8.4.title: Fillet the junction after a boss
0.8.4.blurb: After a new boss a prompt offers to fillet the edges where it meets the body, and a Section control clips the part while you edit.

0.8.3.title: Fillet and Chamfer round the corners of an overhang
0.8.3.blurb: Where one block overhangs another, the four edges at the corner now get a rounded or mitred patch, for the two-lines pick, any subset and Select all connected, where the result used to be stepped or refused.

0.8.3.title: Tangent chain picks a whole run
0.8.3.blurb: With Tangent chain on, picking one edge selects and lights its whole run as one item with its edge count, and clicking any edge of it removes the run.

0.8.3.title: One scrolling list for your selection
0.8.3.blurb: The Selection tray and the editors' edge and corner fields share one list that scrolls in its own box, fills on hover and has Clear.

0.8.3.title: A large STEP file opens as a quick preview
0.8.3.blurb: A STEP file of 8,000,000 characters or more opens as a mesh-only preview with an assembly tree and hide toggles, instead of waiting for the exact import.

0.8.3.title: Install a plugin from its own zip
0.8.3.blurb: A SolidCraft plugin zip installs in the app, with a form built from its parameters, a live preview, picks from the viewport, a Plugins ribbon tab and a Cut list you can download.

0.8.2.title: Extrude can taper the whole outline
0.8.2.blurb: In the Extrude editor, End scale scales the outline to a factor at the far end, so 0.5 ends at half size. It works on any profile, holes included, and with blind, mid-plane and flip ends.

0.8.2.title: Press Pull continues a face straight, with a taper
0.8.2.blurb: Pick a flat face, choose Continue: Straight and a distance: a positive one adds a piece, a negative one cuts one. Add a Draft angle or an End scale and the panel shows the wall angle it makes.

0.8.2.title: Heat-set seat on a hole
0.8.2.blurb: Pick a round hole and choose Heat-set seat: the insert panel opens with the insert at the hole's mouth, along its axis, in the size whose hole is nearest.

0.8.2.title: Messages appear once, in one tidy stack
0.8.2.blurb: Messages stack at the bottom right, wrap long text with Show more and Copy, stay long enough to read and pause while you hover. The status bar shows an Alerts count; click it for the last 50.

0.8.2.title: Moving one piece of a split face makes a step
0.8.2.blurb: Split a face in two, pick one half and use Move Face: that half rises or sinks with a wall along the split line, and picking it no longer shows the size box that moves the whole extrude.

0.8.1.title: Z up is the default, with upright Front and Right planes
0.8.1.blurb: New parts start Z up, the way 3D printing and most newer CAD work. In a Z-up view, Front and Right stand upright when you sketch on them and Top is the ground plane; the plane names and the tree follow. Parts you already have open as they did, and Settings switches back to Y up.

0.8.1.title: Recognise features rebuilds an imported STEP as editable steps
0.8.1.blurb: After you import a STEP file, Recognise features (beta) reads its holes, fillets and outline, rebuilds it step by step and checks that the volume matches the file. Open it as a new part and the steps sit in one From STEP folder, with the file's exact body (Original (STEP)) beside it so you can switch either off and compare.

0.8.1.title: Teardrop holes for 3D printing
0.8.1.blurb: Pick a round hole, choose Teardrop hole, and CadKit adds a peak above it so a horizontal hole prints without support. You set which way is up and the overhang angle, can cut the tip flat, and apply it to every hole of a pattern at once, in one folder you can switch off.

0.8.0.title: A feature edits in a card over the model
0.8.0.blurb: On a wide window, open a feature and its editor appears as a floating card with labelled fields, dropdowns and sections, while the left panel keeps the tree. The raw column of field names on the right is off by default; Settings brings it back. Phones and narrow tablets keep their single panel.

0.8.0.title: Plugins: generators you can add
0.8.0.blurb: Features > Plugins adds a form-driven generator (a case, a spring) in one undo step, edits it later with Edit parameters, and moves the whole thing with Move folder. Compiled plugins use SolidCraft's plugin format, so SolidCraft plugins (tried with its Woodwork cabinets) run here once packed; switch on "Allow plugins from other people" to install them from a zip or a GitHub address, and they run in a sandbox. Doors and drawers do not swing yet; checked in Chrome and Safari so far.

0.8.0.title: The Sketch tab keeps Select and Finish in view
0.8.0.blurb: Select and Finish stay pinned at the left of the Sketch ribbon while the tools scroll, Import DXF and Import SVG are in a new Import group inside a sketch, and the scroll arrows no longer cover tools.

0.8.0.title: More SolidWorks parts open with their history
0.8.0.blurb: Drafted boss faces, fillets round a closed curve and bosses closed by a chord now rebuild as features, so more parts open editable instead of as one imported body. A feature the kernel cannot read back still ends the history there.

0.7.4.title: Text along a curve
0.7.4.blurb: Draw a construction line, arc or spline where lettering should run, tick Along a curve and pick it. The letters follow the curve, move with it, and can be centred, slid along or put on the other side.

0.7.4.title: Trays, bins and baseplates
0.7.4.blurb: The Tray wizard makes a Gridfinity tray or bin on a grid you choose, with the foot, scoops and magnets; set Make to Baseplate for the plate its foot seats in.

0.7.4.title: An iPad-style layout, round two
0.7.4.blurb: Fold the left panel with one tap on its edge, keep Undo and Redo in a card beside the tool column, and the tools can always be brought back. Made for an iPad-style screen; not yet tried on a real iPad.

0.7.3.title: A Create menu with the shapes
0.7.3.blurb: Box, Cylinder, Sphere, Cone, Torus, Boss and Slot are on the ribbon: pick one, click a face or plane, and it is placed. Press Pull pushes or pulls picked faces, and Combine joins the bodies under faces you pick.

0.7.3.title: Rings, tubes and springs from numbers
0.7.3.blurb: Torus, Pipe, Coil and Bounding solid need no sketch. Set the radii, the wall, the pitch and the turns in the Editor, and the shape follows as you type.

0.7.3.title: Dome, Split face and Offset surface
0.7.3.blurb: Raise a dome (or cut a dimple) on a round flat face, split a flat face in two along a plane without cutting the body, or make a new surface a set distance from faces.

0.7.3.title: Fillets on a twisted extrude
0.7.3.blurb: Round the top edges of a twisted extrude: a 40 mm square twisted 30 degrees takes a 2 mm fillet all the way round, where before the fillet was refused.

0.7.2.title: A layout made for iPad
0.7.2.blurb: In portrait the canvas gets two thirds of the screen, the panel tabs are icons, and the sketch ribbon is one row you swipe across, with an arrow and a fade at the edge that still hides tools.

0.7.2.title: The keyboard follows the pen
0.7.2.blurb: Lift the pen or a finger after drawing a circle and the radius field opens with the keyboard up. Every field that can go negative has a plus/minus key, and pen strokes and a resting palm are handled.

0.7.2.title: Updates apply themselves
0.7.2.blurb: When you come back to the installed app and a newer version is out, it reloads itself if nothing is unsaved and shows what it updated to. A setting in Settings turns this off.

0.7.1.title: Round the edges of a case
0.7.1.blurb: The Case wizard has a Round the edges setting: Side edges, Top edges or both, each with its own radius. The case now stands upright on the Top plane, and the wizard no longer leaves the construction sketches drawn in the view.

0.7.0.title: Right-click a hole to add a bolt
0.7.0.blurb: Select a hole wall, right-click and choose Add fastener to hole. The size comes from the hole, the length from the material, with an optional washer and nut and a checkbox for all identical holes on the same plane. Everything goes in as separate bodies in one undo step.

0.7.0.title: A Case wizard: a box with a lipped lid in one step
0.7.0.blurb: On the Features tab, Case takes the outside size, wall thickness, corner radius, lid height and the lip (tongue height, width and clearance) and makes the Base and the Lid, with the tongue on one half and a groove on the other.

0.7.0.title: Split body and Lip joint
0.7.0.blurb: Cut a body at a plane into two named bodies, or add a tongue and a groove with a clearance along the cut. The guide builds a two-part case with the volumes checked.

0.7.0.title: Rib with fillet, draft and one-sided thickness
0.7.0.blurb: The Rib editor gains a fillet on the free edge, a draft angle, a choice of side and the bodies it extends to. A rib no longer fills a bore its line runs through.

0.7.0.title: Nut, Standoff and Heat-set insert wizards
0.7.0.blurb: Parametric hex nuts (ISO 4032, 4035, 4033), round and hex standoffs, and heat-set inserts, each with a live preview, from the Features tab. The dimensions are marked unverified until checked against the standards.

0.7.0.title: Patterns in any direction, about any axis
0.7.0.blurb: A linear pattern can run along any direction vector or edge, and a circular pattern about any axis, with a point on the axis, so a bolt circle does not have to sit on the origin.

0.7.0.title: The assistant can measure and check the part
0.7.0.blurb: The Chat and the MCP server can now read distances, clearances, overlaps, wall thickness, draft and manufacturing checks, so an assistant can verify what it built. The injection moulding check also finds undercuts.

0.7.0.title: Script helpers for draft, lip, scale, split and more
0.7.0.blurb: Typed script methods for draft, move face, lip and groove, scale, split, delete body and face, helix, axis, sphere and move body, and sweeps that follow guide curves.

0.6.5.title: Open OBJ, GLB and 3MF files
0.6.5.blurb: Drop or open an .obj, .glb or .3mf file and it is added as a reference mesh, with colours and (for GLB and 3MF) the unit taken from the file. A notice lists what was not read, such as textures and the separate parts of a multi-part file.

0.6.5.title: A Rounded rectangle sketch tool
0.6.5.blurb: Click two corners and the four corners come out rounded. The corner field sets the radius, and a typed radius becomes a dimension on each corner arc; the last radius is kept for the next rectangle. Add spline point inserts a free point on an existing spline.

0.6.4.title: A Spring wizard for compression springs
0.6.4.blurb: On the Features tab, next to Screw and Washer, Spring takes the outside diameter, wire diameter, free length and turns and adds the coil, shows the pitch and the gap between turns and previews it first. Left or right hand, along any axis; a spring() call does the same from a script. The ends are plain wire ends for now.

0.6.4.title: Slotted sheet metal parts from SolidWorks read back in full
0.6.4.blurb: A folded sheet with slots cut through it, such as a chute, no longer stops at an imported remainder with the slots missing. If the sheet cut cannot take a cut, it is applied as a plain cut and the feature row says so.

0.6.4.title: A second propeller no longer lands on the first
0.6.4.blurb: The Marine propeller wizard has a Position along the shaft setting, starts a new propeller behind the ones already in the part, and warns before inserting an identical one at the same place.

0.6.3.title: Chat: ask for a change in words
0.6.3.blurb: The new Chat panel runs the Claude Code you already have on your own computer. Describe a part or a change, watch it build in the open document, and undo the whole edit in one step. It is off until you start the local service and link the app.

0.6.3.title: Document tabs, right-click menus and a one-row sketch bar
0.6.3.blurb: Open parts are tabs in the top bar. Right-click a feature, a plane, a tab or an open sketch for the commands you expect there, and the sketch bar now stays on one row.

0.6.3.title: Midpoint guides and value boxes that grow with a formula
0.6.3.blurb: While you draw, the pointer also lines up with the middle of an existing line, and with two midpoints it lands where their dotted guides cross. The length, angle and radius boxes widen as you type a formula such as =width*2+wall.

0.6.1.title: Roughness, metalness, clear coat and wood grain
0.6.1.blurb: The Display menu's Surface group sets how a part catches the light, and draws a wood grain with the ring spacing, contrast and colour you choose.

0.6.1.title: Textures from Poly Haven
0.6.1.blurb: Pick a wood texture from the free Poly Haven library in the Display menu and the part is drawn with it, with roughness, a size slider and the author credited. Online libraries are off until you allow them.

0.6.1.title: Choose the mass unit and digits
0.6.1.blurb: Settings > General > Mass display shows a mass in grams, kilograms, pounds or ounces with 3 to 6 digits, everywhere a mass appears.

0.6.0.title: A fold can cross a window
0.6.0.blurb: A fold line through a window or hole of a sheet metal part now bends the part and cuts the window through the bend.

0.6.0.title: Delete both
0.6.0.blurb: Delete something others use and the notice names what depends on it, with a Delete both button that removes them together in one step.

0.6.0.title: The BOM as plain text
0.6.0.blurb: Copy as text and Save as text give the bill of materials as aligned columns, ready for an e-mail, next to Save CSV.

0.6.0.title: More woods and panels
0.6.0.blurb: Birch, cedar, cherry, Douglas fir, eucalyptus, maple, teak and walnut join the Material list, each with its own colour, density and source.

0.6.0.title: A Washer wizard
0.6.0.blurb: Pick a flat or spring washer size from ISO 7089, ISO 7093-1 or DIN 127 B, or type your own, and it lands in the tree as one folder.

0.5.0.title: A Sheet metal tab
0.5.0.blurb: Convert a solid to sheet, add edge flanges, hems and corner reliefs, cut across bends and round or chamfer corners. Edge flange, Hem and Corner open with their pick list ready: tap the edges or corners in the model, tap again to take one out.

0.5.0.title: Flanges on part of an edge, with shaped legs
0.5.0.blurb: An edge flange can cover the whole edge, a start and length along it, or the span between two points you pick, with shaped legs, holes and relief. Bases with rounded corners take flanges too.

0.5.0.title: SolidWorks sheet metal opens as editable sheet metal
0.5.0.blurb: Open an SLDPRT sheet metal part and its flanges come back as editable Edge flange features, with partial-width and sketched-profile flanges, leg rounds, slots and holes.

0.5.0.title: Arc slot
0.5.0.blurb: A curved slot in the sketch tools: pick the centre, the start of the slot and its end, then set the radius and width.

0.5.0.title: Dimension to the part's own edge
0.5.0.blurb: With the Dimension tool, click an outer edge of the part to set how far a slot or hole sits from it.

0.5.0.title: Library
0.5.0.blurb: Samples is now Library: every library in one picker, a Manage libraries list, pictures on saved parts, and Insert into this part on each card.

0.5.0.title: One filter for the Library
0.5.0.blurb: A category menu and tags with counts narrow the Library cards, and Clear brings everything back.
